meta.title: Window & Quit (dsh-window-control)
meta.description: Tired of going fullscreen by hand every time you open Harness? This plugin fills the screen for you: auto-maximize (keeps the window buttons) or true fullscreen on launch, then maximize / restore / minimize / always-on-top at any time. Quit with a native confirmation dialog, triggered by Esc, double Esc or Ctrl+Q - Esc leaves fullscreen first. The window channel is installed by the plugin itself, so no extra script or Python is needed; the first install takes effect after two DSH restarts.
